question: Does the frozen rank-64 weight-derived MLP coefficient generator transfer to later disjoint temporal-v13 and is/was-v12 corpora?

frozen_program.input_bases: rank-64 effective-covector SVDs reconstructed only from temporal-v11/is-was-v10; even uses A1 gates and odd uses A2 gates
frozen_program.test_rows: 24 temporal-v13 plus 24 is/was-v12 A1/A2 rows, text-disjoint from the basis corpus
frozen_program.operation_program: exact cue/post-cue attention value factors plus MLP coefficients read through the frozen rank-64 residual-input bases
frozen_program.noise: 10% relative Gaussian jitter applied only to MLP input deltas, three frozen seeds

predictions.pred_a_authority_hash_disjointness_exact: all authorities replay, train/test texts are disjoint, and uncompressed weight-covector coordinates close at RSE <=1e-10
predictions.pred_b_rank64_ood_coefficient_prediction: held-out coefficient RSE is <=0.10 for every MLP site, task, and projector fit
predictions.pred_c_rank64_ood_program_is_target_suff: both fits have worst target residual <=0.15 and signed behavior projection >=0.80 on each task
predictions.pred_d_rank64_ood_program_is_selective: controls have margin RMS <=0.10 of target scale, median full-vocabulary KL <=0.02 nat, and top-1 flip fraction <=0.05
predictions.pred_e_rank64_ood_program_survives_input: under every frozen 10% noise seed, both fits retain worst target residual <=0.20 and signed behavior projection >=0.75 on each task

decision: Passing promotes a cross-corpus, weight-derived MLP input reader. Failure distinguishes coefficient-transfer, end-to-end composition, control, and noise fragility without refitting rank or directions.
